theme: Earthy Brutalism (Warm architecture meets Swiss layout precision)
brand_context: Rafeek Homes - Construction & Real Estate in Sivagangai, TN. Premium, warm, trustworthy.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk or Clash Display (Banned: Inter, Roboto).

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none

colors.rules: No pure white backgrounds for main sections; always tinted bone/sand. No generic gradients.

layouts.strategy: The Swiss Grid / Architectural Grid. Exposed 1px border lines dividing sections to feel like blueprints.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 to py-32 for sections.
layouts.bento_grid: Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Projects. Asymmetrical, never perfectly filling a standard row.
layouts.containers: Avoid standard centered wrappers. Use full-width grids with internal padding.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid layout with border-black/10 on section boundaries.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders and high contrast instead of soft drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero text requires strong contrast; if over image, use bg-black/40.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis is mandatory for the entire site.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line masked text reveal. overflow:hidden parent, y:100% to 0 child. Staggered.
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll for slow image y-axis translation inside bounded containers.
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee with 'PREMIUM VILLAS • SIVAGANGAI • RAFEEK HOMES •' - slow, architectural typography.

component_instructions.general: Do not use Shadcn default cards for marketing layouts. Build raw semantic HTML with Tailwind.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Textarea, Button for the Contact Lead form. Customize to remove rounded corners.
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges, hover animations (bg-text_primary text-white), strict rectangle.
component_instructions.stats: Large typographic numbers using Framer Motion count-up effect if possible.
component_instructions.youtube_videos: Embed real YouTube iframes within custom aspect-video clipped frames.

accessibility.focus: Focus states must have high contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
accessibility.contrast: Text over images MUST have text-shadow or a dark gradient overlay.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: all interactive elements must have semantic kebab-case data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL LIBRARIES: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/lenis react-fast-marquee lucide-react
FILES: Work entirely in .jsx/.js files, NO TypeScript.
HERO SECTION: Implement a massive height hero. Use Framer Motion to mask-reveal the H1 line-by-line on load.
MANIFESTO/ABOUT: Create a numbered list (01, 02, 03) outlining core values.
SERVICES: Grid layout showcasing Construction, Homes for Sale, Villas, Interior Design.
PROJECTS: Clipped image frames, asymmetrical bento grid. Hover effects on images.
YOUTUBE SECTION: Section for embedded YouTube videos linking to 'rafeek homes'. Use youtube logo provided.
STATS: Large typography for homes built, sq.ft, happy families.
MARQUEE: Insert an editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee between major sections.
CONTACT: Implement a working form mimicking lead generation. Include the address (Muthu Nagar, Sivaganga - 630561) and Phone (9994556889).
TESTIMONIALS & CAREERS: Clean, typography-driven, no generic cards.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered text alignments. Use optical left alignment.
Do not add universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target transitions specifically.
No emojis for UI icons, use lucide-react exclusively.
Generous spacing: use py-24, py-32 to create breathing room.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on headers; always apply a solid color or backdrop-blur.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
